newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm ends with extended losses.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm ends with extended losses.

text.p: Malaysia palm oil prices ended lower, extending Friday's losses, with news of unsupportive September export data and lack of export tender prompting selling, traders said.
They said some buying support and shortcovering emerged at the lower level.
"The market was bearish but there was some buying at the lower levels," a trader said, noting buying was mainly at around 1,141 and 1,142 ringgit for December futures.
"Initially, there were brisk sellings after the December futures contract broke the support of 1,150 ringgit," he said.
